_comment: Machine-readable copy of TOKENS.md. Every value comes from the design boards (Tokens.dc.html and the THEMES objects in each board). Fields marked 'repoCurrent' come from crates/ui/src/theme/tokens.rs as it stands. Nothing here is invented; 'null' means the boards do not say.

source.themesObjectIn: every light board script (Library, LibraryEmpty, Recording, RecordingOutputs, RecordingReview, Consent, Jobs, Devices, Settings, Onboarding, ErrorStates, MoreScreens, Components)

units: points (pt) unless stated; the boards are drawn at 1 CSS px = 1 pt

colorRoles.name: bg_canvas
colorRoles.usage: panel_fill. The window behind every surface: rail, toolbar, status bar.
colorRoles.highContrast: unchanged, see crates/ui/src/theme/tokens.rs HIGH_CONTRAST_LIGHT and HIGH_CONTRAST_DARK

colorRoles.name: bg_surface
colorRoles.usage: extreme_bg_color, inactive widget fill, cards, table body, text fields.
colorRoles.highContrast: unchanged, see crates/ui/src/theme/tokens.rs HIGH_CONTRAST_LIGHT and HIGH_CONTRAST_DARK

colorRoles.name: bg_raised

overlay.note: alphaByte is round(alpha*255), arithmetic only. The boards state the alpha as a decimal.

shadow.scope: Modal and popups only: window_shadow and popup_shadow
shadow.note: The boards also draw this shadow under the ComboBox popup, the context menu and toasts, which are popups.

spacing.mainRegionPadding: space(6) = 24 (Tokens board). Boards measure 20 vertical on Library, Jobs, Settings and Devices, which is off the scale

pill.use: Jobs filter chips, from the Jobs mapping strip: CornerRadius 13, full pill

radius.count_badge: Activity bell count is a 18 pt circle (radius 9)

mono.use: 0:01:07 and content hashes; boards also use 12, 11 and 10 in places

lineHeight.note: Boards state 1.5 for md. 1.25 is the repo's line_height_tight and is not drawn on any board.

fontStack.eguiProposal: Inter Regular and SemiBold TTF through FontDefinitions (OFL, one licence-register row). Today the shell uses egui's built-in proportional face and Hack for mono. The Tokens board says the layout holds with either.

motion.continuousAnimation: A spinner while work runs; nothing else

focus.paint: widgets.active.bg_stroke today. Proposed: 2 pt ring painted 2 pt outside the rect (rect.expand(4)) so it never sits on an accent fill

sizes.tableHeaderHeight: 32 on the Library board, 30 on the component sheet

contrastMeasured.formula: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, same as tokens::contrast_ratio
contrastMeasured.reproduced: All 34 rows were recomputed while writing this spec and match to two decimals

Disabled controls are exempt under WCAG but still draw text_secondary at 0.6 alpha (Tokens board). The component sheet and the error-state mapping strip say 0.5 alpha for disabled buttons. Two boards disagree

boardDisagreements: Table header height: 32 (Library board mapping) vs 30 (component sheet)
Disabled alpha: 0.6 (Tokens board) vs 0.5 (component sheet buttons, error-state mapping strip); the disabled text input on the component sheet uses 0.6
Modal title size: xl 19 (Tokens board, Consent board h2) vs 15 bold (component sheet dialogs)
Nav rail mark: 24 pt (Brand board text), 26 (rail header markup on every screen board), vec2(24,28) (Brand mapping)
Collapsed rail width: 52 (component sheet) vs 56 (COLLAPSED_WIDTH in crates/ui/src/shell/nav.rs)
